title.value: NeoRS: a neonatal resting state fMRI data preprocessing pipeline
title.justification: The title explicitly describes the paper's focus on the NeoRS pipeline for neonatal resting state fMRI data preprocessing.
title.quote: NeoRS: a neonatal resting state fMRI data preprocessing pipeline

extractions.description: The paper presents NeoRS, an open-source pipeline developed for preprocessing resting state functional MRI (rsfMRI) data in neonates. It addresses the unique challenges of neonatal brain imaging, such as differences in brain size and contrast compared to adults. The pipeline includes steps like image registration, skull stripping, tissue segmentation, and motion correction, optimized for neonatal brain data. NeoRS has been tested on datasets, such as the Baby Connectome Project, and offers features like seed-based functional connectivity analysis. It aims to facilitate robust and accessible analysis of neonatal rsfMRI data.
